caption:
Lille beat Bayern Munich, handing them first loss of season

Aleksandar Pavlović · Sport

Lille beat Bayern Munich in the Champions League, giving Bayern their first loss of the season. Aleksandar Pavlović scored an own goal for Lille's winner, the French side's first group win over Bayern. Injuries are affecting Vincent Kompany's squad as the head coach returns to work after a health scare.

Reported by The Guardian.
